standard: Outage management system export: customers out by feeder
cadence: every 15 minutes for each of 17 feeders, plus a row at the minute of a few sudden changes

fields.name: feeder_id
fields.notes: equipment_id of the feeder breaker (scada_tags.json), e.g. GW-SUB02-CB-6

fields.name: cause
fields.notes: cause code as entered by the outage desk: STORM, EQUIPMENT, TREE, VEHICLE, ANIMAL, PLANNED, UNKNOWN; empty when nobody is out

fields.name: est_restoration_utc
fields.notes: estimate at that time; empty while damage is being assessed

joins: customers_out / customers_served scales the feeder current tags GW.SUBn.CBx.CURR.PV in the historian; totals by time give customers without power system-wide
